info_notes.title: Spawn Notes
info_notes.body: These are NIGHT spawns. At each of these spots the game picks either the Flatwoods Monster or the Mothman, and the Flatwoods Monster only spawns at night (the game's IsTimeSpanAnyNight check), with a 5% chance when it is picked — about 2.5% a visit. The events that spawn it are under Events & Activities.
